Company Description About EIT RawMaterials As the world moves towards
a greener future, the demand for raw materials—minerals and
metals—is set to increase immensely over the next three decades.
Europe faces a critical challenge in securing a stable supply of these
essential resources. This challenge is where EIT RawMaterials steps
in. EIT RawMaterials is at the forefront of driving innovation and
sustainability in the raw materials sector. As an Innovation Community
within the European Institute of Innovation and Technology (EIT), we
collaborate with over 300 partners across industry, academia, and
research institutes. Together, we forge dynamic, long-term
partnerships to develop innovative solutions that meet Europe's
growing demand for raw materials. The Role We are seeking an
experienced Head of Academies (m/f/d) to provide operational
leadership for the European Raw Materials Academy and the European
Advanced Materials Academy. The European Raw Materials Academy and the
European Advanced Materials Academy are flagship European initiatives
that develop the skills and talent needed to strengthen Europe’s
competitiveness and industrial transformation in the raw and advanced
materials sectors. Reporting to the Director of Education & Skills,
the Head of Academies is responsible for translating strategic
priorities into operational delivery and ensuring the successful
implementation, scaling, and continuous improvement of both Academies.
The Head of Academies (m/f/d) provides direct line management to three
Senior Education Managers who collectively lead a multidisciplinary
team of approximately 20 colleagues. The ideal candidate combines
operational excellence with an entrepreneurial mindset and a proven
ability to scale digital education initiatives. Success will be
measured through learner growth, program quality, operational
performance, and delivery against agreed Academy KPIs. Key
Accountabilities The Head of Academies is accountable for: 1.
Operational Delivery • Translate strategic priorities into
operational plans and ensure successful delivery against agreed
objectives, KPIs, timelines, budgets, quality standards, and
compliance requirements. • Establish and maintain effective
operational processes, governance, reporting, and continuous
improvement across both Academies. 2. Education Portfolio & Digital
Learning Platforms • Lead the operational management and continuous
improvement of the Academies' digital learning ecosystem, providing
recommendations to support strategic decision-making. • Drive
learner growth, program quality, and an excellent learner experience
through effective operational management and data-informed
decision-making. 3. Team Leadership • Lead, coach, and support the
Senior Managers responsible for Operations, Course Development, and
Partnerships. • Foster a high-performing, collaborative, and
accountable multidisciplinary team. 4. Operational Performance &
Resources • Manage operational budgets within agreed frameworks,
supplier relationships, and procurement activities to support the
successful delivery of both Academies and ensure efficient and
compliant use of resources. • Develop, monitor, and report on
Academy KPIs, analyse operational performance, identify risks and
opportunities, and recommend continuous improvement initiatives. 5.
Stakeholder Collaboration • Maintain productive relationships with
internal teams and other key stakeholders to ensure alignment,
successful delivery, and sustainable growth of both Academies. What
We’re Looking For Required • Experience leading professional
learning, education, or workforce development programs. • Proven
success scaling digital education, EdTech, or professional learning
initiatives. • Operational leadership and program management
experience, including digital learning platforms and Learning
Management Systems. • Demonstrated success leading multidisciplinary
teams and delivering against ambitious KPIs and operational
objectives. • Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder
management skills. • Excellent written and spoken English. Desirable
• Background in EdTech, professional education, or corporate
learning and development. • Experience building or scaling education
academies, digital learning platforms, or comparable education
initiatives. • Familiarity with EU-funded projects, Horizon Europe,
Erasmus+, or the EIT ecosystem. • Understanding of quality
assurance, certification, credentials, and micro-credentials. •
Working knowledge of additional European languages. What We Offer •
The opportunity to lead the operational scaling of two flagship
European Academies with significant strategic impact. • Join a
committed, mission-driven team working at the intersection of
education, innovation, industry, and European policy. • Work with
leading European universities, industry partners, and public-sector
organisations to help shape the future workforce for the raw and
advanced materials sectors. • Hybrid working environment in Berlin.
• Competitive salary. Position Details • Location: Berlin,
Germany. • Contract: Full-time. • Duration: Fixed-term contract
until 2029, with the possibility of extension. • Travel: Occasional
travel within Europe is required. • Reports to: Director of
Education & Skills, EIT RawMaterials. Commitment to Diversity: EIT
RawMaterials is committed to diversity and inclusion. We encourage
applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of background.

Ipsos Ipsos is one of the world's largest research companies and currently the only one primarily managed by researchers, ranking as a #1 full-service research organization for four consecutive years. With over 75 different data-driven solutions, and presence in 90 markets, Ipsos brings together research, implementation, methodological, and subject-matter experts from around the world, combining thematic and technical experts to deliver top-quality research and insights. Simply speaking, we help the biggest companies solve some of their biggest problems, serving more than 5000 clients across the globe by providing research, data, and insights on their target markets. Ipsos Healthcare is the world's leading provider of quantitative and qualitative market research studies in the pharmaceutical and medical technology sectors. The focus is on doctors, medical professionals, and, above all, patients. Our range of solutions is very diverse and covers traditional primary market research as well as scientific Real-World Evidence studies. In collaboration with our national and international clients, we conduct studies along the entire lifecycle of a healthcare product, from early demand and quality-of-life studies to projects for the preparation and accompaniment of product launches (including success measurements) and studies that help already launched products or approved preparations achieve greater success. We are looking for a Project Executive (f/m/d) starting January 1, 2027 for our Healthcare team at one of our locations in Hamburg, Berlin, Frankfurt, Nuremberg or Munich. Please note that this position is initially a two-year fixed-term contract. Your role You support the planning, coordination, and delivery of healthcare market research and innovation projects from proposal stage through to execution. You work closely with project managers, insights teams, suppliers, and other stakeholders to ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and according to quality standards. You coordinate external suppliers and partners, tracking project progress and supporting the management of timelines, deliverables, and documentation. You maintain project documentation and ensure that project records, specifications, and study materials are complete, accurate, and up to date. You support data management activities, including data validation, quality control, and preparation of deliverables using tools such as Excel and other reporting platforms. You contribute to testing activities for surveys, research platforms, and project workflows, helping to identify issues and support process improvements and automation efforts. You assist in monitoring project risks, resolving operational challenges, and ensuring smooth collaboration across internal and external teams. You act as a reliable point of contact for suppliers and internal stakeholders, providing regular status updates and ensuring transparency throughout the project lifecycle. You contribute to the continuous improvement of project management processes, tools, and ways of working, including the use of AI and automation solutions. You collaborate with colleagues across Ipsos Germany and the international Healthcare network to support successful project delivery. Your profile You hold a university degree, preferably in business administration (focus on marketing/market research), social sciences, psychology, communication science, health science/public health, or a comparable field. You have initial professional experience in project management, market research, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, medical technology, or a related field through internships, working student positions, or early-career employment. You have a strong interest in project coordination, operational excellence, and delivering high-quality client work. You possess strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and a structured approach to managing multiple tasks and deadlines. You are comfortable working with data and have advanced Excel skills; experience with SPSS, Power BI, or Python skills are a plus. You have an interest in data management, process optimization, testing, and automation. You demonstrate strong communication and stakeholder management skills and enjoy collaborating with suppliers, clients, and cross-functional teams. You are fluent in English; German language skills are a plus. You are proactive, team-oriented, and motivated to learn and grow in an international healthcare research environment. Experience working with AI-based solutions, survey platforms, reporting tools, or research technologies is a plus. What we offer At Ipsos, you can expect an international and innovative working environment. We serve renowned clients across almost all major industries and work on exciting projects worldwide! You can look forward to: Hybrid work Flexible working hours Workation in European countries Ipsos Corporate Benefits Subsidy for the Germany public transport ticket (Deutschlandticket) Job rotation opportunities Development & learning culture International collaboration Events & local community Diversity & inclusion initiatives Corporate social responsibility programs Modern workplace Interested? The German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) is one of Europe’s largest cancer research centers. “Research for a life without cancer" is the mission of our world-class scientists and all our team members.

The DKFZ is a place where the brightest minds pursue bold ideas and seek answers to pioneering scientific questions through collaboration, innovation, and exploration across many disciplines. We provide a dynamic environment which empowers excellence with state-of-the-art technologies, cutting edge infrastructure, and a global scientific network.

Contribute your knowledge, vision, and dedication to create a space where scientific discovery in cancer research is transformed into benefits for human health.

Together with selected university partner sites, the German Cancer Research Center has established the German Cancer Consortium (https://dktk.dkfz.de/en) (Deutsches Konsortium für Translationale Krebsforschung, DKTK). The alliance between the DKFZ, as the core center, and the university partner sites in Berlin, Dresden, Essen/Düsseldorf, Frankfurt/Mainz, Freiburg, Heidelberg, Munich, and Tübingen joins forces at eight joint translation centers. The DKTK promotes interdisciplinary preclinical translational research topics to accelerate the transfer of results into new approaches for prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of cancer and to develop strategies for personalized oncology. The consortium supports the training of the next generation of medical and clinician scientists, operates state-of-the-art, highly specialized research infrastructures and technical platforms, and promotes the transfer of innovations to the economy and society.

For the Research Group "Adaptive Glycan Remodeling in Cancer Progression" (https://amulyasreekumar.owlstown.net/)  (headed by Amulya Sreekumar) at the DKTK partner site Berlin, the DKFZ is seeking, starting in January 2027, a PhD Student in Cancer Biology.

We are seeking a highly motivated PhD student to investigate the mechanisms driving breast cancer progression. Approximately 30% of breast cancer patients who are disease-free after initial therapy ultimately develop local or metastatic recurrences seeded by therapy-evasive residual tumor cells. Such cells often exist in a dormant state and subsequently exit dormancy, thus giving rise to recurrences. We are interested in the molecular mechanisms that promote residual tumor cell persistence after therapy and their subsequent reactivation.
Building on our recent discovery that tumor cell-autonomous glycan biosynthesis supports dormant cell persistence, this project aims to identify therapeutic strategies that disrupt glycan-mediated signaling to eliminate residual tumor cells and prevent lethal recurrence. The work will integrate mechanistic molecular biology, functional genomics, and advanced cancer models to achieve this goal.

The successful candidate will join the DKFZ International PhD Program (https://www.dkfz.de/en/career/international-phd-program) and work in a collaborative environment spanning DKFZ and Charité/DKTK Berlin. This partnership provides access to cutting-edge core facilities, including high-content imaging, flow cytometry, and genomics technologies at both institutions.
Our laboratory is located within the Department of Hematology, Oncology, and Cancer Immunology at Charité-Campus Virchow Klinikum in Berlin.

Your Tasks

- Performing molecular biology, cell biology, and biochemistry experiments using human and murine breast cancer models 
- Working with genetically engineered mouse models and transplantable tumors
- Gaining problem-solving and analytical skills through active participation and training
